bridge.title: Local bridge
bridge.howTo: Start the bridge on this computer (Python 3.10+) and enter the pairing code it shows:

instance.title: Archicad project
instance.none: No Archicad open. Open Archicad with the Tapir add-on, then refresh.

prepare.title: Prepare Archicad
prepare.zoneLayer: The Zone tool's default layer is “{{layer}}”. During the transfer zones are created on “MS - Massenstudie”, then that setting is restored.
prepare.storiesDiffer: Archicad's stories do not match the project levels. Several levels fall on the same story, so their zones overlap.
prepare.storiesTestOnly: Untitled project: the stories can be adjusted. Elements already placed on a story follow its new height.
prepare.storiesManual: Stories are only adjusted automatically in an untitled (test) project. In a saved project, adjust them in Archicad (Design › Story Settings) or keep the offset placement.
prepare.storiesDone: Archicad stories adjusted. The preview below reflects them.

preview.title: Preview
preview.summary: {{zones}} zones, {{morphs}} volumes, {{slabs}} slabs on {{storeys}} levels, on layer “MS - Massenstudie”.
preview.storiesUnchanged: Each level goes on the nearest Archicad story below it, with an offset where needed.

warning.noStories: The Archicad project has no stories.
warning.noMasses: The active variant has no masses.
warning.teamwork: Teamwork project: elements must be reservable.
warning.librariesMissing: Libraries unavailable in Archicad: {{names}}. If the zone stamp is in one of them, Archicad refuses zones; they are then replaced by volumes.
warning.levelWithoutStory: Level {{level}} m ({{label}}) has no Archicad story at that height: placed on “{{story}}” with an offset.
warning.belowLowestStory: Level {{level}} m ({{label}}) is below the lowest Archicad story.
warning.sharedStory: Levels {{labels}} all fall on story “{{story}}”: their zones overlap and Archicad refuses them. They will be created as morphs. Adjust the stories to avoid this.

result.zoneFallback: Archicad refused every zone (zone stamp or library missing). Volumes were created instead. Load the project's Archicad library and transfer again.
result.standIns: {{count}} zones refused by Archicad (overlap) were replaced by morphs.
